relationships.subject: GAT211
relationships.evidence_quote: GAT211 and analogs do not affect the conformation of TMH7 but instead facilitate the movement of TMH6 [142], leading to G-protein-biased signaling.

key_findings: Classical CB1 orthosteric agonists are fairly unbiased, whereas allosteric ligands (e.g. GAT211, GAT1601) can selectively favor G-protein or beta-arrestin signaling.
CB1 suppresses nociception at DRG, spinal cord and PAG; biased allosteric ligands may dissociate therapeutic from adverse effects.
